q1.instructions:
Tokens are split at spaces and at each punctuation mark. Where does the [[ ]] token stand in a name of one of these kinds: person, place, organisation, work, thing? Other names, ordinary words, dates, numbers, and marks that are not part of a name's own spelling are OUT.

Snippet: [[Oslo]]

criteria.BEGIN: first token of a name of two or more tokens
criteria.INSIDE: a middle token of a name
criteria.END: last token of a name of two or more tokens
